messages.subject: Re: Interactive plot display
parts:
Which Plot are you interested in?

For example, if you want to expand date axis in line chart you can use this:

http://nvd3.org/ghpages/lineWithFocus.html (you can do it both in R or using javascript)

If you're interested in scatter plot you might want to use this one, or just use GGplots contour options (its not interactive, but will allow you to deal with too many points)

http://nvd3.org/ghpages/scatter.html

messages.author: 880cc91712438af6
messages.subject: Re: Interactive plot display
parts:
library(rCharts) #instructions on how to download it in:http://ramnathv.github.io/rCharts/
data(economics, package = 'ggplot2') # example using economics data set from ggplot2
## {title: Line with Focus Chart }
ecm <- reshape2::melt(economics[,c('date', 'uempmed', 'psavert')], id = 'date')
p7 <- nPlot(value ~ date, group = 'variable', data = ecm, type = 'lineWithFocusChart')
p7$xAxis( tickFormat="#!function(d) {return d3.time.format('%b %Y')(new Date( d * 86400000 ));}!#" )
p7

Notice that this graph is interactive, you click on each data point and see its value, you can also remove + add new series from the legend

for other examples see https://github.com/ramnathv/rCharts/blob/master/inst/libraries/nvd3/examples.R
